```json
 "rationale": "Budget is 21.7 uA total. Iref is assumed to be at most 10 uA. About 9.5 uA remains for the tail and stage 2. The weak-inversion NMOS pair (gm/Id about 18) maximises gm per uA. Short-L devices keep the o1 capacitance near 5 fF and limit saturation depth. The two cascaded integrators give about 1.5-2 ns, and the inverter adds about 0.4 ns into 50 fF. M5 copies the mirror VSG, so o2 balances. Polarity: non-inverting OTA, then inverting CS, then inverter."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (18.0, 10.0, 24.0),   # diff pair gm/Id (weak inversion for gm/uA)
    "L1":    (0.18, 0.15, 0.5),    # diff pair L
    "gmidp": (10.0, 7.0, 14.0),    # PMOS mirror / CS gm/Id (shared -> matched VSG)
    "Lp":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),     # PMOS mirror / CS L
    "Lb":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),      # NMOS bias mirror L
    "ftail": (0.58, 0.4, 0.75),    # fraction of available current to the tail
    "Wn_inv": (1.0, 0.42, 4.0),    # inverter NMOS width (um)
    "kp_inv": (2.5, 1.5, 4.0),     # inverter PMOS/NMOS width ratio
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 50e-15)
    vod = spec.get("vod", 0.01)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    p_max = 39e-6

    # ---- current budget ----
    i_avail = max(0.9 * p_max / vdd - iref, 4e-6)
    itail = p["ftail"] * i_avail
    i2 = i_avail - itail

    # ---- bias mirrors (NMOS, from ibias diode) ----
    gmid_b = 10.0
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gmid_b, p["Lb"], iref, vds=0.7)
    mbt = lut.size("n", gmid_b, p["Lb"], itail, vds=0.4)
    mb2 = lut.size("n", gmid_b, p["Lb"], i2, vds=0.9)

    # ---- preamp: NMOS diff pair, PMOS mirror load ----
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], itail / 2, vds=0.4)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], itail / 2, vds=1.0)   # diode side
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], itail / 2, vds=1.0)   # output side

    # ---- stage 2: PMOS CS (same VSG as mirror -> balanced), NMOS current load ----
    m5 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], i2, vds=0.9)

    # ---- output inverter ----
    Wn = p["Wn_inv"]; Wp = p["kp_inv"] * Wn; Linv = 0.15

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("MBT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mbt)
    n.dev("MB2", "o2", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb2)
    # preamp: M1 (vinp) on diode side, M2 (vinn) on output side -> o1 non-inverting
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    # CS stage (inverting)
    n.dev("M5", "o2", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m5)
    # inverter (inverting) -> vout HIGH when vinp > vinn
    n.M("MN7", "vout", "o2", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Linv)
    n.M("MP7", "vout", "o2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Linv)

    # ---- predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    c1 = m5.cgg + m4.cdd + m1.cdd + 1e-15
    try:
        cg_n = lut.op("n", Wn, Linv, 0.9, 0.9)["cgg"]
        cg_p = lut.op("p", Wp, Linv, 0.9, 0.9)["cgg"]
    except Exception:
        cg_n = Wn * Linv * 1e-14 + Wn * 0.5e-15
        cg_p = Wp * Linv * 1e-14 + Wp * 0.5e-15
    c2 = cg_n + cg_p + m5.cdd + mb2.cdd + 0.5e-15
    w1 = gm1 / c1
    w2 = m5.gm / c2
    # two cascaded integrators: v2 = vod*w1*w2*t^2/2 reaching ~0.9 V
    t_lin = math.sqrt(2 * 0.9 / (vod * w1 * w2))
    # inverter drive into CL (approx sat current at Vgs=VDD/2+)
    try:
        idn = lut.op("n", Wn, Linv, 1.2, 0.9)["Id"]
        idp = lut.op("p", Wp, Linv, 1.2, 0.9)["Id"]
        t_inv = cl * 0.9 / max(min(idn, idp), 1e-6)
    except Exception:
        t_inv = 0.4e-9
    t_rec = 0.4e-9   # recovery of preamp from previous saturated state
    tpd = t_lin + t_inv + t_rec

    power = vdd * (iref + itail + i2)
    a1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m4.gds)
    a2 = m5.gm / (m5.gds + mb2.gds)

    return n, {"tpd": tpd, "power": power, "polarity_ok": 1,
               "gain1_db": db(a1), "gain2_db": db(a2)}
```
